title: 第78章 山雨欲来第77章 五贼六宝
content_zh:
陆家府邸，陆景山捏着那封来自登仙楼的信，眉头微挑，眼中满是诧异。
“这吴燃灯……”他指尖在信上“五贼不足为虑”六字上轻点，“五峦山那帮煞星都堵到家门口了，他哪来的底气照常举办南山符会？”
旁侧的族老接口道：“族长，那五贼可是实打实的法种境高手，独门法术驱之大成。尤家那三小族前车之鉴不远，但吴隐官此人博通诸经，自有谋略，不是孟浪之人。他如今敢选如期举办，难道真藏着什么不为人知的后手？”
陆景山沉吟不语。
他与吴燃灯打过几次交道，只觉此人看似年轻，手段却深不可测，从符文拓印到整合各族，每一步都出乎预料。
如今五贼气焰正盛，他竟有恃无恐，想必不是空穴来风。
“哼，五贼虽横，我陆家也不是吓大的。”陆景山将信往案上一拍，眼中闪过厉色，“他吴隐官敢孤身赴险，我陆家身为南山大族，岂能露了怯？”
陆景山随后对前来送信的孙氏兄弟二人朗声道：“转告吴隐官，七日后南山符业之会，我陆家必到。届时不仅会带齐入股明细，族中护卫也会随行，倒要看看，那五峦山五贼能掀起多大风浪！”
孙伯龙拱手应道：“陆族长深明大义，属下一定转告大人。”
待二人离去，族老仍有顾虑：“族长，咱们真要掺和进去？万一……”
“没有万一。”陆景山打断他，目光望向窗外，“南山符业成了，我陆家能更上一层楼。若是不成，被五贼占了先机，咱们日子只会更难。吴燃灯敢赌，我陆家便陪他这一局。”
他拿起案上的刻碑玄铁凿，指尖摩挲着冰冷的凿刃：“法种境又如何？我陆家亦是不缺。
真要撕破脸，我陆家传承千年，哪怕付出代价，也未必不能将这五贼留下。
唯有这南山符业，利益太大，前景太广，我陆家付出再大代价，也不能缺了这一席。”
……
方家药老捻着胡须，看着孙伯龙带来的消息，指尖在茶盏沿打转：“吴燃灯此子这步棋，实在够野。”
旁侧的家族长老接口：“五峦山五贼可不是善茬，他单枪匹马就敢接招？”
“非常之人，行非常之事，如此方见胆识。”药老放下茶盏，眼中精光一闪，“他能逆向破解符文拓印之玄机，此子又怎能不一般。如今敢硬撼五贼，必有后手。”
他提笔在帖子上落下名字，“七日后登仙楼，方家子弟随我同去，给他撑场子。这等人物，值得压这一重注。”
……

司乐女家主抚摸着祖传的玉笛，笛孔间还残留着灵气。
听完孙伯龙的转述，她轻笑一声：“吴燃灯敢捋五贼的虎须，没想到文外表下，竟有此果断坚毅之气。”
身后的族中子弟问道：“族长，真要去？五贼睚眦必报……”
“怕什么？”女家主拿起玉笛吹奏起来，清越的声音穿堂而过，“他有胆识掀桌子，咱们就有魄力帮他按住桌角。这等人物成了事，南山符业格局必变，司乐家岂能缺席？”
她收笛而立，“备车，七日后登仙楼，司乐家全员到场。”
……
孙伯龙将三家的回话报给吴燃灯时，他正对着道经进行批注。
闻言，吴燃灯笔尖一顿，符纸上溅出个墨点，却嘴角微扬：“三大仙族倒是爽快。”
他悠悠望去，远处的五峦山方向，隐隐传来五贼的咆哮。
而南山之郡，三大仙族也已整装待发。
一场好戏，就等七日之后了。
山海鬼市一角，李家、郑家、成家的族长聚在一处，同时收到了吴燃灯的来信，被反复传阅观看，气氛凝重如铅。
尤家等三族被灭的惨状犹在眼前，五贼的凶戾让他们唇亡齿寒。
这几日，三家已将族中老弱护在一处，青壮轮流值守，生怕被五贼逐个击破，此刻面对吴燃灯的邀约，更是举棋不定。
“去还是不去？”李家主攥紧了手中之剑，用力之下，剑刃颤抖发出错乱剑鸣，“去了，怕是要被五贼视作眼中钉，尤家的下场就在眼前。”
郑家主叹了口气：“可不去…三大仙族都已经应了约，若是被他们瓜分了偌大的南山符业，之后就会长久垄断，咱们这些小族往后就更无出头之日，怕是比死还难受。”
成家主眉头紧锁：“吴燃灯虽有手段，可五贼是法种境啊的左道高手，咱们这点家底，经不起折腾。”
三人争执犹豫间，孙伯龙兄弟在旁开口了，：“我家仙主派我二人来时，特意额外加了一份口信。仙主说了，三大族已经确定赴会，商谈符业份子。来与不来，全凭诸位心意，仙主绝不强求。”
这话看似平淡，却像一块石头投入死水。
三人对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了挣扎。
content_en:
In the Lu family's residence, Lu Jingshan held the letter from Dengxian Tower, his brows slightly raised, his eyes full of surprise.
"Wu Randeng..." He tapped the words "Five thieves are nothing to worry about" on the letter with his fingertips. "The evil stars from Wuluan Mountain have blocked the door of his house. How can he have the confidence to hold the Nanshan Talisman Festival as usual?"
The clan elder on the side said: "Clan leader, those five thieves are real masters of the Dharma Realm, and are very successful in driving them away with their own magic. The three small clans of the You family have learned from the past, but Wu Yinguan is a man who knows all the scriptures and has his own strategies. He is not a member of Meng Lang. Now that he dares to choose to hold the event as scheduled, is he really hiding some unknown back-up plan?"
Lu Jingshan was silent.
He had dealt with Wu Randeng several times, and found that this man seemed young, but his methods were unfathomable. From rune rubbing to integrating various tribes, every step was unexpected.
Now that the five thieves are at their peak, he is so confident that they must not be unfounded.
"Hmph, even though the five thieves are tyrannical, I, the Lu family, are not intimidated." Lu Jingshan slapped the letter on the case, a stern look flashed in his eyes, "Guan Wu Yin dared to go into danger alone. As a big family in Nanshan, how can I, the Lu family, be so cowardly?"
Lu Jingshan then said loudly to the two Sun brothers who came to deliver the letter: "Tell Wu Yinguan that the Lu family will be at the Nanshan Fuye meeting in seven days. Not only will we bring the details of the shareholding, but the clan guards will also accompany us. Let's see how much trouble the five bandits of Wuluan Mountain can cause!"
Sun Bolong cupped his hands and responded: "Clan Chief Lu understands the righteousness, and my subordinates will definitely tell you."
After the two left, the clan elder still had concerns: "Clan leader, do we really want to get involved? What if..."
"There is no such thing as a chance." Lu Jingshan interrupted him and looked out the window, "If the Nanshan Fu industry is completed, my Lu family can go to a higher level. If it fails and the five thieves take advantage of us, our life will only be more difficult. Wu Randeng dares to make a bet, and my Lu family will accompany him in this game."
He picked up the black iron chisel on the table and rubbed the cold chisel blade with his fingertips: "What about the legal realm? Our Lu family is also not lacking.
If we really want to break up, my Lu family has been inherited for thousands of years, and even if we pay the price, we may not be able to keep these five thieves.
Only this Nanshan Talisman Industry has too many benefits and too broad prospects. No matter how high the price is, our Lu family cannot afford to miss out on this position. "
…
Yao Lao of the Fang family twisted his beard, looked at the news brought by Sun Bolong, and swirled his fingertips on the rim of the tea cup: "Wu Randeng's move is really wild."
The family elder on the side said: "The five thieves of Wuluan Mountain are not easy to deal with. How dare he accept the attack single-handedly?"
"Extraordinary people do extraordinary things, and this shows their courage." Yao Lao put down the tea cup, his eyes flashed, "He can reverse the mystery of rune rubbings, so how can this kid be extraordinary? If you dare to challenge the five thieves now, you must have a backup plan."
He picked up his pen and wrote down his name on the post, "I will go to the Immortal Tower in seven days. The children of the Fang family will accompany me to support him. This kind of person is worthy of this heavy investment."
…
The female head of the Si Le family caressed the ancestral jade flute, and there was still spiritual energy left in the flute hole.
After listening to Sun Bolong's narration, she chuckled: "Wu Randeng dared to stroke the beards of the five thieves. I didn't expect that underneath his appearance, there was such decisiveness and perseverance."
The clan members behind him asked: "Clan leader, do you really want to go? The five thieves will be punished..."
"What are you afraid of?" The female head of the family picked up the jade flute and started playing. Qingyue's voice passed through the hall, "If he has the courage to lift the table, we will have the courage to help him hold the corner of the table. When such a person becomes successful, the pattern of Nanshan's talisman industry will definitely change. How can the Si Le family be absent?"
She put away her flute and stood up, "Prepare the car and go to the Immortal Tower in seven days. All members of the Si Le family will be present."
…
When Sun Bolong reported the responses from the three families to Wu Randeng, he was annotating the Taoist Scriptures.
Hearing this, Wu Randeng's pen tip paused, and a dot of ink spattered on the talisman paper, but the corner of his mouth slightly raised: "The three major immortal clans are quite happy."
He looked leisurely and saw the faint roar of the five thieves in the distance in the direction of Wuluan Mountain.
In the county of Nanshan, the three great immortalsThe tribe is also ready to go.
A good show will wait for seven days.
In a corner of the Shanhai Ghost Market, the heads of the Li family, the Zheng family, and the Cheng family gathered together. At the same time, they received a letter from Wu Randeng, which was circulated and read repeatedly. The atmosphere was as solemn as lead.
The tragic situation of the You family and other three clans being wiped out was still before their eyes, and the brutality of the five thieves left them with a chill in their lips.
In the past few days, the three families have kept the old and the weak in one place, and the young and the strong have taken turns to guard, for fear of being defeated by the five thieves one by one. At this moment, facing Wu Randeng's invitation, they were even more hesitant.
"To go or not to go?" The head of the Li family tightened his grip on the sword in his hand. Under the force, the blade trembled and made a chaotic sword sound. "If you go, I am afraid that you will be regarded as a thorn in the side of the five thieves. The fate of the You family is right in front of you."
The head of the Zheng family sighed: "Don't go... The three major immortal clans have already agreed to the agreement. If they divide up the huge Nanshan Talisman industry, they will have a monopoly for a long time. We, a small clan, will have no future in the future. I am afraid it will be worse than death."
The head of the Cheng family frowned: "Although Wu Randeng has the means, the five thieves are masters of the right path in the Dharma realm. Our family cannot withstand the abuse."
While the three of them were arguing and hesitating, Brother Sun Bolong spoke from the side, "When my Immortal Master sent us two here, he specially added an extra message. The Immortal Master said that the three major clans have decided to attend the meeting to discuss the members of the Fu industry. Whether you come or not depends entirely on your wishes, and the Immortal Master will never force you."
These words may seem ordinary, but they are like a stone thrown into stagnant water.
The three of them looked at each other and saw struggle in each other's eyes.
